title: Chapter 475
paragraphs: Chapter 475
Episode 133. Times of Choices (2)
What Dox McRolan saw were numerous humans. More precisely, it was a sort of 'tower' made up of numerous humans.
It seemed to be about ten steps tall.
The humans forming the tower had bizarrely crumpled and folded bodies, looking like large bricks.
Dox had experienced countless battlefields filled with blood, bones, and flesh, but he had never seen a tower stacked with humans like this before.
He instinctively held his breath. The terrible stench and the poison of decay made it seem as if his lungs would rot. It was also difficult to bear the nausea.
'They're alive.'
The distorted humans who became the bricks of the tower.
They were all alive.
Despite their waists being completely bent backward, their necks twisted, and their bodies crumpled into square shapes, they were still breathing.
Creaking and gasping sounds came from various places in the tower as the humans barely breathed. The tower swelled and sank with each of their breaths.
And their eyes.
Numerous eyes were blinking. There were eyes that simply closed and opened without focus, as well as eyes that seemed to have some intention as they moved their gaze.
The latter seemed to be trying to look at Dox.
'Is it a kind of ancient dark magic? Or a ritual for summoning a god? Either way...'
It should never have happened in Hupester or Runcandel.
Of course, this place was an 'execution ground.' Most of the humans who became the tower were likely to be serious criminals, but even so, such a thing should not have happened.
Dox didn't care how the prisoners died, but this was an act of desecrating the land that worships war and struggle.
-As soon as you recover, head to the city of Recalton in the southern region of Hupester. Investigate the truth about what is happening in Recalton.
He remembered the words of the 12th
generation.
'Even I, a black knight, knew nothing about Recalton. The 12th generation has lower document access authority than me, so how did they find out about this place?'
The 12th generation had an information power that far exceeded expectations.
Naturally, he could come to that conclusion. In reality, it was closer to accidentally discovering it from a story Emma told rather than Ticen's information power.
Anyway, that was not a very important issue. The really important issue Dox was thinking about was, 'how many people in the family know this fact?'
'And the owner of this facility and their purpose.'
Family head, acting family head, Black Sword Association chairman, top-ranked generation.
Only those people could own a facility of this scale without anyone knowing. Siron and Luna were out of the question, and the chairman of the Black Sword Association recently lost his position.
'If it had been owned by the Black Sword Association chairman, someone in the Council of Elders would have exposed this facility to gain favor.'
What remained were the acting family head and the top-ranked generations.
'The likelihood that it's the work of Rosa and the 2nd generation is the highest...'
The 3rd and 4th generations could not become such villains. Runtia had lived like someone who had given up on the world until recently, and Diphus couldn't do it because of Meri.
On the other hand, Rosa and Joshua were different. Above all, Recalton was a land dedicated to Joshua.
'After giving up the throne, Rosa sometimes showed an inexplicable obsession with the 2nd generation.'
In the process, they killed everyone around the 1st generation and captured them, a story that all the black knights knew.

'A senior told me that there was a circumstance where the acting family head and the 2nd generation had contact with magicians capable of curses when the 12th generation chose Barisada in the selection ceremony. It was just a circumstance, though.'
His head heated up.
It was because he remembered the fact that the senior retired not long after telling that story due to an injury during a mission.
He was naive. It couldn't have been an ordinary injury, and Dox shook his head.
'Still, I have to go back to the 2nd generation. I need to verify for myself if this place is really his and report to the family head...'
At that moment, Dox thought.
Gahahaha, hahaha-!
Suddenly, laughter echoed from various parts of the human tower. It was the voice of the humans who had become the bricks of the tower. Dox prepared to draw Clo and took a defensive stance.
"Ahahaha!"
A woman's laughter followed. Dox instinctively knew that the owner of the voice was the administrator of this facility.
Her footsteps echoed.
The woman walked out from between the human towers.
She was a prophet.
"Well, here's a question for the foolish intruder."
The prophet stopped walking.
Her face was hidden in the deep shadow, but her physique was not large and she seemed quite young.
"What is this place for?"
Dox did not answer, but glared at the woman. Despite feeling defenseless, he couldn't reach out with Clo for some reason. His body stiffened like an herbivore encountering a predator.
The Black Knight of Runcandel.
"This stupid child! You have no clue, do you? Then the next question!"
The prophet spread her palm.
Whooosh...!
Black energy gathered above it. The power of Soldelet, the spirit energy, spread through the prophet's palm.
"Whose place is this?"
The prophet smirked, and Dox had to feel as if he had been hit on the back of the head with a blunt object. Seeing the spirit energy, he thought that the prophet was closer to Jin than Joshua.
"I am the contractor of Soldelet, a relative of Jin Runcandel. So, the Black Knight of Runcandel, you must pay the price for coming here without permission."
"...I came here under the order of the 12th generation."

"Ahaha, if that's true, my master must have played another cruel joke. Anyway, I can't just let you go. Submit quietly and let yourself be captured. I'll check with my master. If you resist, I'll kill you."
Gahahaha, hahaha! The human towers laughed, as if echoing the prophet.
His body was not as usual. He had come to Recalton to settle his debt with Jin without fully recovering.
'It's impossible to fight and win in this condition.'
He had to escape.
As soon as he made the decision, he turned around. The prophet shook her head as if disappointed as Dox moved.
"Tsk, this is no fun."
The prophet stretched out her hand, and a purple beam was fired. Dox couldn't help but think of the Black King Mine when he saw the purple beam that brushed past his shoulder.
'This power is, Zephirin. It's almost the same as what that monster used!'
He shuddered, and his back went cold. He had never faced such a devastating defeat while living as a warrior like that day.
Once again, purple beams penetrated Dox's body. Most of them could be avoided or deflected, but a few were missed.
Unfortunately, the missed beams' positions were not good. Heart and neck, certain death.
For some reason, as death approached, the face that came to mind was not his comrades from Runcandel, but a completely unexpected person.
And so, just as he was about to call out that name in his heart.
"Dox, snap out of it!"
Crack!
Someone was knocking down the beams that were flying towards Dox's heart and neck.
"...That's all, Your Majesty."
The Imperial Palace.
Ratz, bandaged all over his body, reported to the emperor. Although many people were sent to the Gaipa Army Road, only five, including Ratz, whom Jin had deliberately left as witnesses, returned.
Even those five returned in a state of severe injury. Ratz, too, had his tendons severed and could no longer live as a special task force captain. It was impossible even for ordinary movements.
Unlike Jin, the Prochi siblings had no qualms about making their enemies as miserable as possible, even if they didn't harbor much resentment.
"It's a shame that mercenary Amella died... Hehe, quite a harvest, though."
Those were the first words the emperor uttered after Ratz's report.
The 'harvest' the emperor mentioned was none other than Jipl's living golem and the magic stone.
"Jipel's biotic golem technology is indeed more effective than our own mineralization. Even without being a contractor, they can use divine powers."
Brrr, a shiver ran down his spine. The world's best, Jipel's power always inspired awe in the emperor.
"Marashin Stone, Miron Jipel must have resurrected using that thing called Marashin Stone!"
The emperor stood up and exclaimed in admiration.
Since Jin was a reserve member, no, even before he was born, he had been curious about the name of that object. The name of the stone that the great Jipel had longed for!
"Yes, Your Majesty. From the circumstances, Sandra Jipel's super-regeneration and Miron's resurrection seemed to be phenomena caused by the Marashin Stone."
"It must come at a great cost. It is definitely stronger than mineralization, but mass production is still a distant goal."
The second harvest the emperor was thinking of was information about Jin and Murakan.
"Jin Run Kandel."
The emperor recalled Jin with a smile.
Although their first encounter was disappointing, the emperor did not ignore Jin's potential.
However, he was certain that people who sought 'friendship' in the battle among the highest authorities would naturally become extinct.
The recently reported martial arts of Jin and Murakan gave him the thought that they might be a variable like 'Shiron' in the future, though the possibility was slim.

'Is it the self-confidence unique to those like Shiron Run Kandel or Baek Gyeong, knowing that all information about Jipel will be reported to me...? What is the reason for sparing Ratz and sending him back, Jin Run Kandel?'
Is it a provocation?
Or is it that such information is not that important? Either way, the emperor felt a sense of discomfort, as if Jin was 'looking down on him.'
The emperor chuckled lightly.
'Well... Anyway, my discomfort is nothing compared to the pain you will soon feel.'
A sneer formed at the corner of the emperor's mouth.
In Geom Hwangseong.
He was curious about Jin's reaction when the slowly recovering main house of Hailan crumbles once again.
Hailan had been isolated like a fallen island since the Geom Hwangseong terror incident.
Jipel constantly pressured Hailan, the royal court did not protect them, and Ron, who needed the prestige of Geom Hwang more than ever, was reducing his external activities day by day.
There were even rumors that Hailan could fall like this, and the emperor had the will to make that rumor a reality.
"I wonder how much that man of steel will cherish his friendship. I'm looking forward to it."
The emperor mumbled to himself as he sorted out his thoughts. However, he did not know that the reason Jipel had been putting unusually strong pressure on Hailan recently was because of Jin.
"Ratz."
"Yes, Your Majesty."
"I will give you a new mission. As soon as your body changes, keep an eye on Ron's movements."
